description: CRIT-004's claim that the 27-case closed matrix covers every required boundary and invalid-data case is false: it has only a single over-limit financial row and no aggregate-overflow case made from individually safe rows, and its MENTAL invalid-time case omits resolved_at before occurred_at and at or after period end.

evidence.snippet: The financial unsafe fixture uses one amount 9007199254740992, while the MENTAL fixture covers only absent and unparsable resolved timestamps. The matrix contains no individually-safe aggregate overflow, resolved-before-occurred, or resolved-at/after-end fixture required by the authoritative specs.

resolution.notes: The 27-group closed matrix now independently asserts a two-row individually-safe aggregate overflow variant and MENTAL absent, unparsable, before-occurred, exact-end, and after-end resolution timestamps in both production scorer and independent oracle.
